laravel.runtime: Canonical ExecutionJobStore lifecycle and recent-query behavior is adapted onto the existing tenant-owned executions persistence model without creating a competing execution runtime.

acceptance.existing_runtime_only: The adaptation reuses the accepted tenant-owned executions architecture and does not introduce a second execution_jobs table, queue, or ownership model.
acceptance.canonical_lifecycle: Focused tests cover start, progress reporting with canonical clamping, completion, failure, cancellation, direct lookup, site-filtered recent lookup, and canonical minimum take behavior.
acceptance.tenant_scope_isolation: ExecutionJobStore resolves sites and executions through TenantContext-backed tenant-scoped models; focused tests prove cross-tenant reads, mutations, and cross-tenant site starts fail closed without altering foreign jobs.
acceptance.missing_and_invalid_state: Focused tests prove missing mutation targets and invalid oversized current-step state fail closed while preserving previously persisted job state.
acceptance.redaction: Failure details redact credential-shaped Authorization/Bearer/token material before persistence and focused tests assert secret values are absent from returned job evidence.
